No idea how I have not reviewed this game yet. This is one of my favorite games to play with friends and family, it has kept me engaged for hours and hours. It is incredibly irritating in the beginning stages, but these are also the most fun, dinosaurs are a real threat and can destroy your base and tools, adding an element of suspense and intrigue. My only critique of the game is that as you get into the late game and you prepare to battle the bosses, it is an endless grind to attempt to achieve the amount of level 250 t rexes required. So that sucks, and so does the building lowk, but with some mods this can be fixed. Besides that, its amazing, would totally recommend it for someone and friends, alone maybe no.
